Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

open — to start an app or a file. Example: Open the app.
close — to shut an app or a window. Example: Close the app when you finish.
send — to make something go to a person. Example: Send me the photos.
call — to telephone someone. Example: Call me later.
write — to make words with a pen or keyboard. Example: Write a message.
